name: Voyant AI Chatbot – Learns Your Website Automatically
author: Charlie Hersant

sections.description:
Voyant AI Chatbot is an AI chatbot for WordPress and WooCommerce that answers customer support questions and WooCommerce product questions from your own website. Connect it and it reads your published pages, posts and products, keeps what it knows up to date automatically, and answers visitors in your voice, pointing them to the right page with a real link. You never start from scratch, and there is no AI provider account or API key to manage. There is a free plan to start with.

When it can’t answer something, it tells you, and you add the answer in a click so it keeps getting better. And when you do want better answers, you are not on your own: the built-in Help assistant is an AI coach that knows your assistant. Ask it why an answer looks wrong and it looks at your settings and your visitors’ real questions, tells you exactly what to change, and drafts the fix for you to approve with one click.

A Voyant AI account is required. The plugin is the connector between your WordPress site and the Voyant AI service, which runs the assistant. Nothing is sent to Voyant until you connect your site.

What it does

  • Learns from your published pages, posts and WooCommerce products, and re-learns when you edit them.
  • Answers customer support and WooCommerce product questions with your own information. For shops it knows prices, stock and options, and can offer an add-to-basket link.
  • Safe to switch on: a newly connected site starts with the chat hidden from visitors, so you can test it privately first. Lead capture also starts off.
  • Test chat: try your assistant in the WordPress admin before visitors see it (it doesn’t use your monthly chats). Voyant may read test chats to improve the assistant.
  • Your own AI coach (new): the Help tab. Ask it anything, such as “why does it keep giving the same answer?” or “what should I teach it first?”. Unlike generic advice, it can see a summary of your own assistant (its settings, what it has learned, the questions visitors recently asked), so it tells you exactly what to fix, step by step. It can draft a fact or answer for you, which is only added when you press Add. Your past Help chats are kept for 90 days so you can read an answer again.
  • Teach it: add facts and answers your website doesn’t cover, and quickly write answers to anything it couldn’t answer.
  • Conversations and leads: read what visitors asked, correct any answer, and collect names and emails if you switch lead capture on.
  • Analytics: see how many questions are asked, when, and a plain-English summary of the topics people ask about, with suggestions for what to teach it next.
  • Look and personality: choose your logo, colours, welcome message, instructions and quick-question buttons. Earlier versions of the instructions are kept, so you can restore one.
  • Control who sees it: choose which user roles can use the plugin, and separately who can read conversations and leads. Hide the chat on chosen pages, on mobile, or delay it.
  • Takes account of a notice you put up (for example “delays in dispatch”) when answering.
  • Optional email updates: a weekly summary, or a note when it couldn’t answer a question.
  • Keep any page out of the assistant’s knowledge with a tick box.
  • Replies in the language your visitor writes in. It is strongest when your site content is in that language.
  • Works with pages built with Beaver Builder, because it reads your content the way a visitor sees it.

For agencies and developers

Voyant AI Chatbot is built to be handed over to clients:

  • One Voyant AI account runs several client websites, each with its own assistant (its own knowledge, look, conversations and leads). The Pro plan runs 5 websites, Growth 15 and Enterprise 40, and the monthly chats are shared across them.
  • Charge your clients whatever you like, including inside a care plan. They do not need a Voyant AI account.
  • A white-label version of Pro, Growth and Enterprise removes the “Powered by Voyant AI” line from the chat window.
  • New sites start with the chat hidden from visitors and lead capture off, so you can test privately first.
  • The Help tab answers “why did it say that?” for your clients, using a summary of their own assistant, so fewer questions reach you.
  • The chat loads as one small script, asynchronously, and runs in a separate frame so it cannot clash with the theme.

Plans and details: https://voyantai.co.uk/agencies

External services

This plugin connects your website to the Voyant AI service (operated by Voyant Websites Ltd, company number 16946394, 9 Bancroft Way, Wootton, Northampton, NN4 6BF, UK), which provides the AI assistant. The plugin does not contact the service until a site administrator connects it (Voyant AI > Connection).

Once connected, the following is sent to https://voyantai.co.uk:

  • Your site content, when you press “Update now” and when content changes: the text of your published pages, posts and products (including prices and stock), your site name, tagline and menus. Password-protected and private content, and pages you tick “Keep out” on, are not sent.
  • Your assistant settings (colours, welcome message, personality, quick questions) and any notice or answers you type in. If you switch on the optional email updates (weekly summary or “couldn’t answer” alerts), the email address you choose for them is also sent, and the service then emails that address.
  • A notice check, every few minutes while connected: the current site notice, only when it has changed (and every few hours while one is active).
  • Your site address and WordPress/plugin version when connecting.

On your public pages, the plugin loads the chat widget script from the same service (https://voyantai.co.uk/loader.js). When a visitor uses the chat, their messages (and any name, email or phone number they choose to give) are sent to the service so it can reply. A random visit identifier (kept in the visitor’s browser only for the tab session) groups a visitor’s messages into one conversation, and thumbs up/down ratings on replies are sent if the visitor clicks them. The service uses OpenAI to generate replies and to build the summaries and topic labels shown in the Conversations and Analytics tabs; personal details such as email addresses and phone numbers are masked before questions are analysed. Test chat: what you type in the plugin’s Test chat, and the assistant’s replies, are kept for up to 90 days so Voyant can see how the assistant is used and improve it. Only Voyant staff can read them; they are not shown to your visitors and don’t count towards your plan. Please don’t type personal or sensitive information there. Help chat: the questions you type in the plugin’s Help tab, and the Help assistant’s replies, are kept for up to 90 days so Voyant can improve its support; only Voyant staff can read them and they don’t count towards your plan. To give advice about your site, the Help assistant is sent a summary of your own assistant (its settings, how much it has learned, and recent visitor questions and replies with email addresses, phone numbers and links masked). Please don’t type passwords or personal information there. You should mention the chat assistant in your own privacy policy.

  • Voyant AI terms of service: https://voyantai.co.uk/terms.html
  • Voyant AI privacy policy: https://voyantai.co.uk/privacy.html
  • OpenAI (sub-processor): https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

To stop all data sharing, press Disconnect on the Connection tab or deactivate the plugin. Ask Voyant to delete your account data at any time.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Voyant AI in the admin menu and go to Connection.
  3. Paste the licence key from your free Voyant AI account (sign up at voyantai.co.uk).
  4. Press Update now. Your assistant learns your site and sets itself up in about a minute.
sections.faq:
What does Voyant AI Chatbot do?

It is an AI chatbot for WordPress and WooCommerce. It reads your published pages, posts and products, answers visitors’ customer support and product questions in plain English with a link to the right page, and shows you what people are asking. When it can’t answer, it tells you and you add the answer in a click.

Do I need an account?

Yes. The assistant runs on the Voyant AI service. See External services above.

Do I need an OpenAI account or an API key?

No. There is no AI provider account or API key to manage. You connect your site with a licence key from your Voyant AI account.

Is it free?

The plugin is free. The Voyant AI service has a Free plan that includes 10 live chats a month and a Test chat for trying your assistant, plus paid plans from £5 a month with larger monthly allowances. Current plans are on voyantai.co.uk.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. It knows your product prices, stock and options, avoids offering what is sold out, and can offer an add-to-basket link. It stays off the checkout page.

What happens if it doesn’t know the answer?

It says so and adds the question to a list. You type the answer once, and it uses it straight away. The Help tab can also tell you what to teach it next.

Can I use it on my clients’ websites?

Yes. One Voyant AI account can run several websites, each with its own assistant, and you can charge your clients whatever you like. See https://voyantai.co.uk/agencies for plans and details.

Can I remove the “Powered by Voyant AI” line?

Yes, on the White-label version of the Pro, Growth and Enterprise plans, which removes it from every website on the account. It stays on the Free and Starter plans.

Does it answer in other languages?

It replies in the language your visitor writes in, using what it has learned from your website. It is strongest when your site content is in that language. If many visitors use another language, teach it the key facts (hours, prices, delivery, contact) in that language.

Does it collect visitors’ personal data?

It handles what a visitor types into the chat, and a name, email address or phone number only if they choose to give one. Email addresses, phone numbers and links are masked before questions are analysed, and the widget sets no advertising cookies. Voyant AI is run by a UK company. See External services above, and mention the chat assistant in your own privacy policy.

What is the Help assistant?

A built-in AI coach on the Help tab. It knows how Voyant AI works and can see a summary of your own assistant: its settings, what it has learned, and your recent visitor questions (email addresses, phone numbers and links are masked). Ask it things like “why does it keep giving the same answer?”, “what should I teach it first?” or “why can’t I see the chat on my website?” and it gives specific steps. It can draft a fact or answer for you, but nothing is added until you press Add.

Does the Help assistant use my monthly chats?

No. Help chats and Test chats never count towards your plan. To keep the service fair there is a daily and weekly limit on Help questions per site. Your past Help chats are listed on the Help tab for 90 days.

Does it slow my site down?

The chat widget loads asynchronously after your page, as one small script, and runs in a separate frame.

What happens when I uninstall it?

The plugin removes its settings from your site. Press Disconnect first if you also want the connection closed on the Voyant AI side.
sections.changelog:
1.12.1

  • Updated listing text and FAQ, including information for agencies and developers. No functional changes.

1.12.0

  • New: Help assistant. A built-in AI coach on the new Help tab. It knows your own assistant (settings, what it has learned, your recent visitor questions with personal details masked), explains why it answers the way it does, tells you what to teach it next, and drafts facts and answers you approve with one click.
  • New: your past Help chats are kept for 90 days and can be reopened to read an answer again or carry on.
  • Help chats and Test chats never use your monthly chats; there is a fair-use daily and weekly limit on Help questions.
  • Privacy: the readme and settings now describe the Help chat data (kept up to 90 days, readable by Voyant staff to improve support).

1.11.1

  • Updated plugin name and listing details.

1.11.0

  • Test chat improvements.

1.10.0

  • Conversations remodelled: chats grouped by visit, full conversation view, topics, filters (needs attention, thumbs down, handled), search and date range.
  • CSV export of conversations and leads.
  • Visitors can rate replies with thumbs up/down.
  • Optional instant email when a new lead arrives.
  • Fixed links in replies showing as raw text.

1.9.1

  • Refreshed plugin listing: new icon and banner, updated description and screenshots.

1.9.0

  • First release on WordPress.org.
